Name: DitherDew
Author: Owenynk112
Description:
[b][color=#783f04][size=5]Description[/size][/color][/b]
DitherDew is an in-game post-processing filter for Stardew Valley. It lays [b]CRT scanlines[/b] and [b]ordered (Bayer) dithering[/b] over the game world for a retro, old-monitor / halftone look. Self-contained — no ReShade, nothing to set up.

[color=#ff7700]Press [b]F8[/b] to toggle it, and tune everything live in [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b].[/color]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48129/48129-1782322637-1340233661.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48129/48129-1782322637-731882833.png[/img][color=#ffd966][size=4][b]No ReShade, nothing to install — runs through the game's own renderer.[/b][/size][/color]
[b][color=#ffd966][size=4][b]Works on PC, Mac and Linux.[/b][/size][/color][/b]
[b][color=#ffd966][size=4][b]Live slider tuning (GMCM) with instant preview.[/b][/size][/color][/b]

[b][color=#783f04][size=5]Settings in GMCM[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Dither strength[/b] — how strongly the dithered look replaces your normal colours[/size][/color][b][color=#ff7700] (0 = original colour, 1 = full retro look).[/color][/b][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=4]Colour levels — how many colour steps are kept.[/size][/color][size=4] [color=#e69138]Lower = chunkier, more visible dithering; higher = closer to the original palette.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Dot size[/b] — size of the dither pattern in pixels; [/size][/color][size=4][color=#b45f06]bigger means coarser "halftone dots".[/color][/size][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Scanline strength[/b] — [/size][/color][color=#b45f06][size=4]how pronounced the scanlines are[/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=4] (compensated, so they add texture without darkening the image).[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Scanline thickness[/b] —[/size][/color][size=4][color=#b45f06] how many pixels tall each scanline is.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Brightness[/b] — [/size][/color][color=#b45f06][size=4]overall brightness[/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=4].[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Saturation[/b] — colour vividness ([/size][/color][color=#e69138][size=4]1 = original; raise for punchier colour[/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=4]).[/size][/color][/*]
[*][size=4][color=#d4d4d8][b]Shade the UI too[/b] — also [/color][color=#ff0000]apply the filter to menus/HUD[/color][color=#d4d4d8] (off keeps text crisp).[/color][/size][/*]
[/list]

[color=#783f04][size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]SMAPI 4.0+. [/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]Generic Mod Config Menu[/size][/color]

[color=#783f04][size=5][b]Install[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]unzip into Mods/, launch through SMAPI, press F8.[/size][/color]
